mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting both muscles was most worthwhile because the poses show how their pulls move the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps repeated the biceps construction, so that part felt predictable.

surprise.text: The explanation that both muscles pull, rather than one pushing the arm back, changed how I pictured elbow movement.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary. The first pairing was the only option, but the resulting picture explained how supporting tissue connects muscle fibres to tendons.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the parts assembled into a working elbow made me curious how another body system would fit together, though some construction was repetitive.
